title: Coil field vs coil current (field-volume probe)
description: Charge the bank and let the coil fire. The field probe sits at the centre of the 48-turn coil and reads the exact field of the modelled solenoid each sample; against the coil's signed current it is a line through the origin with slope μ0·N/√(L² + 4a²) ≈ 3.38 × 10⁻⁴ T/A for L = 154 mm, a = 45 mm. The ideal-solenoid model has no iron armature, so this checks the field model against its textbook formula, not the bench against a gaussmeter. Simulated, not metrology.
